notes.title: 1 Anniversary! Updates!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
First: thank you very much to support Thunderflash and our games! <3

This is the first Anniversary of Thunderflash!
We have released a little update to improve some issues:

- Fixed fullscreen for some GPU (pixel perfect).
- Fixed some graphics glitches.

Here recap all all updates in this first year:

- Added Hardcore Mode!
- Added new languages: spanish, japanese and german!
- Updated some graphics.
- Fixed some glitches.
- Fixed some bugs.
- New cover.

We also announce a special sale for this week!

Still, thank you very much! :D
